description: This Java source file defines the Converters class, which acts as a factory and repository for Converter instances, managing registration, retrieval, and loading of converters within the org.apache.ofbiz.base.conversion package.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A final class providing a factory and repository for Converter objects, including methods for registration, retrieval, and loading converters, as well as internal classes for creating pass-through converters.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverterCreator
classes.description: Inner class implementing ConverterCreator to create pass-through converters when source and target types are compatible.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverter
classes.description: Inner class implementing Converter that returns the input object directly when source and target types are the same.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves a Converter instance for specified source and target classes, creating or finding an existing one, or throwing ClassNotFoundException if none is available.

methods.name: loadContainedConverters
methods.description: Loads all public, non-abstract classes implementing Converter within a specified container class.

methods.name: registerCreator
methods.description: Registers a ConverterCreator to be used when no existing converter matches the source and target classes.

methods.name: registerConverter
methods.description: Registers a Converter instance for specific source and target classes.
